title: Political Ideology and U.S. Electric Vehicle Adoption
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: The prospect for electric vehicles (EVs) as a climate change solution hinges on their widespread adoption across political lines. This paper uses county-level data to show that from 2012-2023, about half of all new EV registrations in the U.S. went to the 10% most Democratic counties. This correlation remains largely stable over time, though EV trucks show a lower correlation than other EV types. We also conducted a survey, finding no difference in the ability of Democrats and Republicans to identify EVs. Overall, our results suggest that barriers to widespread U.S. EV adoption may be greater than anticipated. abstract_zh: 电动汽车（EV）作为应对气候变化的解决方案，其前景取决于其能否在不同政治阵营中得到广泛采用。本文利用县级数据表明，2012年至2023年间，美国约一半的新电动汽车登记量流向了民主党得票最高的10%的县。这一相关性在很大程度上随时间保持稳定，不过电动卡车的相关性低于其他类型的电动汽车。我们还进行了一项调查，发现民主党人和共和党人在识别电动汽车方面的能力并无差异。总体而言，我们的结果表明，美国电动汽车广泛普及的障碍可能比预期的更大。NBER工作论文系列的机构订阅用户及发展中国家的居民可以在 www.nber.org 免费下载本文。

title: Uber and Traffic Fatalities
abstract: Previous studies of the effect of ridesharing on traffic fatalities have yielded inconsistent conclusions. We revisit this question using proprietary data from Uber measuring monthly rideshare activity at the Census tract level. We find a consistent negative effect of ridesharing on traffic fatalities, with impacts concentrated during nights and weekends. Our results imply that ridesharing has decreased U.S. traffic fatalities by 5.2% in areas where it operates. The annual life-saving benefits are $6.8 billion. Back-of-the-envelope calculations suggest that these benefits are of similar magnitude to producer surplus captured by Uber shareholders or consumer surplus captured by Uber riders.

title: Do Tax Credits Increase Heat Pump Adoption?
abstract: Economists have long argued that many recipients of clean energy subsidies are likely non-additional, but there are relatively few empirical studies. This paper uses U.S. monthly shipment data to test whether income tax credits increase heat pump adoption. When the tax credit increased from $300 to $2000 in January 2023, there was no increase in shipments. Then, when the tax credit expired in January 2026, there was no decrease in shipments. This lack of a discernible relationship persists after controlling for seasonal patterns, energy prices, and housing starts. The evidence suggests that most recipients of the $2000 tax credit were non-additional, and would have installed a heat pump even without the subsidy. The paper discusses implications for policy design, economic efficiency, and cost-effectiveness. Finally, the paper points out that heat pump shipments continue at a strong pace thus far in 2026 even without the tax credit, with large benefits for the environment.
abstract_zh: 经济学家长期以来认为，许多清洁能源补贴的受益者很可能并非额外（non-additional）的受益者，但相关的实证研究相对较少。本文利用美国的月度出货数据，检验所得税抵免是否会增加热泵的采用。2023年1月，税收抵免从300美元提高到2000美元，但出货量并未增加。随后，2026年1月税收抵免到期，出货量也没有下降。在控制了季节性模式、能源价格和住房开工数之后，这种无法辨识的关系依然存在。证据表明，获得2000美元税收抵免的大多数受益者属于非额外的，即即使没有补贴也会安装热泵。本文讨论了其对政策设计、经济效率和成本效益的含义。最后，本文指出，即使没有税收抵免，热泵出货在2026年迄今仍保持强劲增长，对环境具有可观的益处。

title: How Much Has Shale Gas Saved U.S. Consumers?
abstract: It may seem like a distant memory now, but as of the mid-2000s, U.S. natural gas production had been flat for a decade, and the U.S. was importing liquefied natural gas (LNG), with plans to import much more. Then shale gas happened. Advances in hydraulic fracturing and horizontal drilling caused U.S. natural gas production to increase significantly, and the U.S. went from being a net importer of natural gas to being the world's largest exporter. This paper calculates how much shale gas has saved U.S. natural gas consumers. Using price differences between the United States, Europe and Japan, we calculate that U.S. natural gas consumers have saved $3.1-$4.3 trillion between 2007 and 2025, equivalent to $164-$227 billion annually. Access to low-price U.S. natural gas has been particularly valuable during major supply shocks such as the war in Ukraine, and the benefits of shale gas have been experienced broadly across sectors and states. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 现在看来，这可能已是遥远的记忆，但到2000年代中期，美国的天然气产量已经十年持平，美国当时正在进口液化天然气（LNG），并计划进口更多。随后，页岩气革命发生了。水力压裂和水平钻井技术的进步使美国天然气产量显著增加，美国从天然气净进口国转变为全球最大的天然气出口国。本文计算了页岩气为美国天然气消费者节省了多少费用。利用美国与欧洲和日本之间的价格差异，我们计算出2007年至2025年间，美国天然气消费者共节省了3.1万亿至4.3万亿美元，相当于每年1640亿至2270亿美元。在乌克兰战争等重大供应冲击期间，获得低价美国天然气尤其具有价值，并且页岩气的收益在各行业和各州都得到了广泛体现。NBER工作论文系列的机构订阅用户及发展中国家的居民可以在 www.nber.org 免费下载本文。

title: Why Did Air Conditioning Adoption Accelerate Faster Than Predicted? Evidence from Mexico
abstract: A common theme in the vast literature on climate change is the estimation of models using historical data to make predictions many decades into the future. Although there is a large and growing number of these types of studies, researchers rarely return later to check the accuracy of their predictions. In this paper, we perform such an exercise. In Davis and Gertler (2015), we used household-level microdata from Mexico to predict future air conditioning adoption as a function of income and temperature. Revisiting these predictions with 12 years of additional data, we find that air conditioning in Mexico has accelerated, significantly exceeding our predictions. Neither errors in predicting income growth or rising temperatures, nor migration patterns, nor an overly restrictive model can explain the large prediction gap. Instead, our results point to the failure to account for falling electricity prices and technological changes in air conditioner efficiency as key drivers of the prediction gap. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 在庞大的气候变化文献中，一个常见的主题是利用历史数据估计模型，以预测未来数十年的情况。尽管此类研究的数量庞大且仍在增长，研究者却很少事后回过头来检验其预测的准确性。在本文中，我们进行了这样一项检验。在Davis和Gertler（2015）中，我们利用墨西哥的家庭层面微观数据，预测了未来空调采用率作为收入和温度的函数。在增加了12年的数据之后重新审视这些预测，我们发现墨西哥的空调普及速度加快了，显著超过了我们的预测。无论是对收入增长或气温上升预测的误差，还是迁移模式，或是模型设定过于严格，都无法解释这一巨大的预测差距。相反，我们的结果指出，未能考虑电价下降以及空调能效的技术变化，是造成预测差距的关键因素。NBER工作论文系列的机构订阅用户及发展中国家的居民可以在 www.nber.org 免费下载本文。

title: Competitive Effects of Entry in Gasoline Markets
abstract: We use panel data on the location, prices, and quality of the universe of gas stations in Mexico to study the competitive effects of entry on incumbent firms. Using more than 1000 entry events and defining local markets based on the road network, we find that the entry of a new station within 3 min driving time decreases regular gasoline prices by 6% of the retail price spread. Competitive effects decline with travel time and are largest in markets that previously had only one station. Entry of stations with the same owner as the incumbent has near‐zero effects. The effect of competition on quality is less clear, with suggestive evidence of improved service quality in some specifications.
abstract_zh: 我们利用墨西哥全部加油站的位置、价格和质量面板数据，研究进入对现有企业的竞争效应。利用1000多次进入事件，并基于道路网络界定地方市场，我们发现，在3分钟车程内新加油站的进入，使普通汽油价格降低了零售价差的6%。竞争效应随出行时间增加而递减，在此前仅有一家加油站的市场中最大。与现有企业属于同一所有者的加油站进入，其效应几乎为零。竞争对质量的影响尚不明确，在某些设定中有服务质量改善的初步证据。

title: The Distributional Effects of U.S. Tax Credits for Heat Pumps, Solar Panels, and Electric Vehicles
abstract: Over the last two decades, U.S. households have received $47 billion in tax credits for buying heat pumps, solar panels, electric vehicles, and other “clean energy” technologies. Using information from tax returns, we show that these tax credits have gone predominantly to higher-income households. The bottom three income quintiles have received about 10% of all credits, while the top quintile has received about 60%. The most extreme is the tax credit for electric vehicles, for which the top quintile has received more than 80% of all credits. The concentration of tax credits among high-income filers is relatively constant over time, though we do find a slight broadening for the electric vehicle credit since 2018. The paper then turns to the related question of cost effectiveness, examining how clean energy technology adoption has changed over time and discussing some of the broader economic considerations for this type of tax credit.
abstract_zh: 在过去二十年间，美国家庭因购买热泵、太阳能板、电动汽车及其他“清洁能源”技术而获得了470亿美元的税收抵免。利用纳税申报表的信息，我们表明，这些税收抵免主要流向了高收入家庭。收入最低的三个五分位组仅获得了约10%的全部抵免，而最高的五分位组获得了约60%。最极端的是电动汽车的税收抵免，其中最高五分位组获得了超过80%的全部抵免。税收抵免在高收入纳税人中的集中程度随时间相对稳定，不过我们确实发现，自2018年以来电动汽车抵免略有扩散。本文随后转向相关的成本效益问题，考察清洁能源技术的采用如何随时间变化，并讨论了这类税收抵免更广泛的经济考量。

title: What Matters for Electrification? Evidence from 70 Years of U.S. Home Heating Choices
abstract: The percentage of U.S. homes heated with electricity has increased steadily from 1% in 1950, to 8% in 1970, to 26% in 1990, to 40% in 2020. This paper investigates the key determinants of this increase in electrification using data on heating choices from millions of U.S. households over a 70-year period. Energy prices, geography, climate, housing characteristics, and household income are shown to collectively explain 90% of the increase, with changing energy prices by far the most important single factor. This framework is then used to calculate the economic cost of an electrification mandate for new homes. Households in warm states tend to prefer electricity anyway, so would be made worse off by less than $350 annually on average. Households in cold states, however, tend to strongly prefer natural gas so would be made worse off by more than $1000 annually. These findings are directly relevant to a growing number of policies aimed at reducing carbon dioxide emissions through electrification.
abstract_zh: 用电采暖的美国住户比例从1950年的1%稳步上升到1970年的8%、1990年的26%，再到2020年的40%。本文利用70年间数百万美国家庭的采暖选择数据，考察了这一电气化增长的关键决定因素。研究表明，能源价格、地理、气候、住房特征和家庭收入共同解释了这一增长的90%，其中能源价格变化是迄今为止最重要的单一因素。随后，我们利用这一框架计算了对新建住宅实施电气化强制规定的经济成本。温暖州的家庭本身就倾向于使用电力，因此平均每年的福利损失不到350美元。然而，寒冷州的家庭则强烈偏好天然气，因此每年的福利损失将超过1000美元。这些发现与越来越多旨在通过电气化减少二氧化碳排放的政策直接相关。

title: Does Regulation Distort Exit Decisions? Evidence from U.S. Power Plants
abstract: Hundreds of power plants have closed in the United States since 2010, including 130+ gigawatts of coal and 50+ gigawatts of natural gas. In this paper, we highlight the potential for regulation to distort this type of exit decision. Using generator-level data from 2010–2023, we show that regulated units have been 45% less likely to exit than unregulated units. For unregulated units, exit decisions are made based on wholesale electricity prices, ongoing capital costs, and other traditional economic factors. In contrast, owners of regulated units are largely insulated from these factors and, in some cases, have a strong incentive to continue operating capital-intensive equipment. Previous work documents how this regulatory distortion affects investment decisions. Our paper emphasizes that these same incentives affect exit decisions as well. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 自2010年以来，美国已有数百座发电厂关闭，其中包括超过130吉瓦的煤电和超过50吉瓦的天然气发电。本文强调，监管可能扭曲此类退出决策。利用2010–2023年的机组层面数据，我们发现受监管机组退出的可能性比不受监管机组低45%。对于不受监管的机组，退出决策基于批发电价、持续资本成本及其他传统经济因素。相比之下，受监管机组的所有者在很大程度上不受这些因素影响，并且在某些情况下，有强烈动机继续运营资本密集型设备。已有研究记录了这种监管扭曲如何影响投资决策。本文强调，这些相同的激励同样影响退出决策。NBER工作论文系列的机构订阅者，以及发展中国家的居民，可在www.nber.org免费下载本文。

title: The Economic Determinants of Heat Pump Adoption
venue: NBER Environmental and Energy Policy and the Economy
abstract: One concern with subsidies for low-carbon technologies is that they tend to go predominantly to high-income households. Previous research has shown, for example, that the top income quintile receives 60% of subsidies for rooftop solar and 90% of subsidies for electric vehicles. This paper finds that heat pumps are an important exception. Using newly available U.S. nationally representative data, the paper finds that there is remarkably little correlation between heat pump adoption and household income. title: Electric Vehicles in Multi-Vehicle Households
abstract: This paper uses U.S. nationally representative data from the 2017 National Household Travel Survey to present a series of facts about electric vehicles (EVs) in multi-vehicle households. First, as of the time of the survey, 89% of households with an EV also had a non-electric vehicle in addition to the EV. Second, 60% of households with an EV also had a non-electric SUV, truck, or minivan. Third, 66% of households with an EV also had a non-electric vehicle that was driven more miles per year. The paper argues that these patterns have significant implications for the environmental impact of EVs and underscore the importance of better understanding how multi-vehicle households substitute between vehicles.
abstract_zh: 本文利用2017年全国家庭出行调查中具有全国代表性的美国数据，呈现了多车家庭中电动汽车的一系列事实。第一，截至调查时，拥有电动汽车的家庭中有89%还拥有一辆非电动汽车。第二，60%拥有电动汽车的家庭还拥有一辆非电动的SUV、卡车或小型货车。第三，66%拥有电动汽车的家庭还拥有一辆年行驶里程更多的非电动汽车。本文认为，这些规律对电动汽车的环境影响具有重要意义，并凸显了更好地理解多车家庭如何在不同车辆之间进行替代的重要性。

title: Evidence of a Homeowner-Renter Gap for Electric Appliances
abstract: This paper provides the first empirical analysis of the homeowner-renter gap for electric appliances. Using U.S. nationally representative data, the analysis shows that renters are significantly more likely than homeowners to have electric heat, electric hot water heating, an electric stove, and an electric dryer. The gap is highly statistically significant, prevalent across regions, and holds after controlling for the type, size, and age of the home, as well as for climate and household characteristics. The paper argues that this gap arises from the same split incentives that lead to the “landlord-tenant problem” and discusses the implications of the gap for an emerging set of policies aimed at reducing carbon dioxide emissions through building electrification.
abstract_zh: 本文首次对电器领域的房主－租户差距进行了实证分析。利用具有全国代表性的美国数据，分析表明，租户比房主显著更可能拥有电采暖、电热水器、电炉灶和电烘干机。该差距具有高度统计显著性，在各地区普遍存在，并且在控制住房类型、面积和房龄以及气候和家庭特征后依然成立。本文认为，这一差距源于导致“房东－租户问题”的同样的激励错配，并讨论了该差距对一系列旨在通过建筑电气化减少二氧化碳排放的新兴政策的启示。

title: Transmission Impossible? Prospects for Decarbonizing the U.S. Grid
abstract: Encouraged by the declining cost of grid-scale renewables, recent analyses conclude that the United States could reach net zero carbon dioxide emissions by 2050 at relatively low cost using currently available technologies. While the cost of renewable generation has declined dramatically, integrating these renewables would require a large expansion in transmission to deliver that power. Already there is growing evidence that the United States has insufficient transmission capacity, and current levels of annual investment are well below what would be required for a renewables-dominated system. We describe a variety of challenges that make it difficult to build new transmission and potential policy responses to mitigate them, as well as possible substitutes for some new transmission capacity.
abstract_zh: 在电网规模可再生能源成本下降的鼓舞下，近期的分析得出结论：美国有望利用现有技术，以相对较低的成本于2050年实现二氧化碳净零排放。尽管可再生发电成本已大幅下降，但要整合这些可再生能源，需要大幅扩建输电网络以输送电力。已有越来越多的证据表明，美国的输电能力不足，而当前的年度投资水平远低于以可再生能源为主的系统所需的水平。我们描述了使新建输电设施变得困难的多种挑战，以及缓解这些挑战的潜在政策应对措施，并讨论了可替代部分新增输电能力的可能方案。

title: Who Will Pay for Legacy Utility Costs?
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: The growing “electrify everything” movement aims to reduce carbon dioxide emissions by transitioning households and firms away from natural gas toward electricity. This paper considers what this transition means for the customers who are left behind. Using historical evidence from growing and shrinking U.S. natural gas utilities, we show that utilities add pipelines but rarely remove them, even when the customer base from which to recover costs is shrinking. Correspondingly, we find that utility revenues decrease less than one-for-one when a customer base is shrinking, consistent with higher bills for remaining customers. We then use our empirical estimates to predict how customer bills might increase in the future for different levels of building electrification. We highlight the equity implications of our results and conclude by discussing alternative utility financing options such as recouping fixed costs through taxes rather than prices.
abstract_zh: 日益壮大的“全面电气化”运动旨在通过使家庭和企业从天然气转向电力，以减少二氧化碳排放。本文考察了这一转型对被留下的客户意味着什么。利用美国人口增长和萎缩地区天然气公用事业的历史证据，我们发现，公用事业公司会增建管道，但即便成本回收的客户群正在萎缩，也很少拆除管道。相应地，我们发现当客户群萎缩时，公用事业收入的下降幅度小于一比一，这与剩余客户账单上升相一致。随后，我们利用实证估计结果，预测在不同建筑电气化水平下，未来客户账单可能如何上涨。我们强调了这些结果的公平含义，并在结论中讨论了替代性的公用事业融资方案，例如通过税收而非价格来回收固定成本。

title: Air Conditioning and Global Inequality
abstract: As global temperatures go up and incomes rise, air conditioner sales are poised to increase dramatically. Recent studies explore the potential economic and environmental impacts of this growth, but relatively little attention has been paid to the implications for inequality. In this paper we use household-level microdata from 16 countries to characterize empirically the relationship between climate, income, and residential air conditioning. We show that both current and future air conditioner usage is concentrated among high-income households. Not only do richer countries have much more air conditioning than poorer countries, but within countries adoption is highly concentrated among high-income households. The pattern of adoption is particularly stark in relatively low-income countries such as Pakistan, where we show that the vast majority of adoption between now and 2050 will be concentrated among the upper income tercile. We use our model to forecast future adoption, show how patterns vary across countries and income levels, and discuss what these patterns mean for health, productivity, and educational inequality.
abstract_zh: 随着全球气温上升和收入增长，空调销量有望大幅增加。近期研究探讨了这一增长的潜在经济和环境影响，但对其在不平等方面的含义关注相对较少。本文使用来自16个国家的家庭微观数据，实证刻画了气候、收入与住宅空调之间的关系。我们发现，当前和未来的空调使用都集中于高收入家庭。富裕国家的空调普及率远高于贫穷国家，而在各国内部，空调采用同样高度集中于高收入家庭。这一模式在巴基斯坦等相对低收入国家尤为突出，我们发现，从现在到2050年之间的绝大多数空调采用将集中于收入最高的三分位组。我们利用模型预测未来采用情况，展示不同国家和收入水平之间的差异，并讨论这些模式对健康、生产率和教育不平等意味着什么。

title: Estimating the Price Elasticity of Demand for Subways: Evidence from Mexico
abstract: This paper uses fare changes in Mexico City, Guadalajara, and Monterrey to estimate the price elasticity of demand for urban rail transit. In two of the cases there is a significant fare increase (30%+), and in the third there is a 60-day fare holiday. Ridership responds sharply in the expected direction in all three cities, implying price elasticities which range across cities from −0.23 to −0.32. In addition, there is suggestive evidence that the temporary fare holiday led to a higher baseline level of ridership. These estimates are directly relevant for policymakers considering alternative pricing structures for urban rail. The paper discusses the relevant economic considerations and then shows how the estimated elasticities can be used to perform policy counterfactuals.

title: An Empirical Test of Hypercongestion in Highway Bottlenecks
abstract: There is a widely-held view that as demand for travel goes up, this decreases not only speed but also the capacity of the road system, a phenomenon known as hypercongestion. We revisit this idea in the context of highway bottlenecks. We propose an empirical test using an event study design to measure changes in highway capacity at the onset of queue formation. We apply this test to three highway bottlenecks in California for which detailed data on traffic flows and vehicles speeds are available. We find no evidence of a reduction in highway capacity at any of the three sites during periods of high demand. Across sites and specifications we have sufficient statistical power to rule out even small reductions in highway capacity. This lack of evidence of hypercongestion stands in sharp contrast to most previous studies and informs core models in urban and transportation economics.
abstract_zh: 一种广为持有的观点认为，随着出行需求增加，不仅速度会下降，道路系统的通行能力也会降低，这一现象被称为超拥堵（hypercongestion）。我们在高速公路瓶颈路段的背景下重新审视这一观点。我们提出一种实证检验方法，采用事件研究设计，衡量排队形成开始时高速公路通行能力的变化。我们将该检验应用于加利福尼亚州的三个高速公路瓶颈，这些地点拥有详细的交通流量和车速数据。我们发现，在三个地点的高需求时段，均没有通行能力下降的证据。在各地点和各种设定下，我们都有足够的统计功效排除即使是较小的通行能力下降。这一缺乏超拥堵证据的结论，与大多数先前研究形成鲜明对比，并为城市经济学和交通经济学中的核心模型提供了依据。

title: Are Energy Executives Rewarded for Luck?
abstract:
In this paper, we examine executive compensation data from 78 major U.S. oil and gas companies over a 24-year period. Perhaps in no other industry are the fortunes of so many executives so dependent on a single global commodity price. We find that a 10% increase in oil prices is associated with a 2% increase in executive compensation. This oil price effect holds for both CEOs and non-CEOs and separately for several different individual components of compensation, including bonuses.
We find that the oil price effect is larger in companies with more insiders on the board, and asymmetric, with executive compensation rising with increasing oil prices more than it falls with decreasing oil prices. We then discuss potential mechanisms drawn from the broader existing literature on executive compensation.
abstract_zh:
本文考察了美国78家主要石油和天然气公司24年间的高管薪酬数据。或许在其他行业中，如此多高管的财富都不如此依赖于单一的全球大宗商品价格。我们发现，油价每上涨10%，高管薪酬相应增加2%。这一油价效应对首席执行官和非首席执行官均成立，并且对薪酬的若干不同组成部分（包括奖金）分别成立。
我们发现，油价效应在董事会内部人较多的公司中更大，并且是不对称的：油价上涨时高管薪酬的增幅大于油价下跌时的降幅。随后，我们结合现有的高管薪酬文献，讨论了可能的作用机制。

title: Do Energy Efficiency Investments Deliver at the Right Time?
abstract: Most analyses of energy efficiency investments ignore that the value of electricity varies widely across hours. We show how much timing matters. Using novel hourly consumption data from an air conditioner rebate program in California, we find that energy savings are concentrated in high-value hours. This significantly increases the value of these investments, especially after we account for the large capacity payments that electricity generators receive to guarantee supply in peak hours. We then use engineering predictions to calculate timing premiums for a wide range of energy efficiency investments, finding substantial variation in economic value across investments. (JEL L94, L98, Q41, Q48)
abstract_zh: 大多数能效投资分析忽视了电力价值在不同小时之间存在巨大差异这一事实。我们表明时机的重要性有多大。利用加利福尼亚州空调返利项目中新颖的逐小时用电数据，我们发现节约的能源集中于高价值时段。这显著提高了这些投资的价值，尤其是在我们考虑了发电企业为保障高峰时段供电而获得的大额容量支付之后。随后，我们利用工程预测，为各类能效投资计算了时间溢价，发现不同投资的经济价值存在显著差异。（JEL L94, L98, Q41, Q48）

title: Heat Exposure and Global Air Conditioning
abstract: Air conditioning adoption is increasing dramatically worldwide as incomes rise and average temperatures go up. Using daily temperature data from 14,500 weather stations, we rank 219 countries and 1,692 cities based on a widely used measure of cooling demand called total cooling degree day exposure. India, China, Indonesia, Nigeria, Pakistan, Brazil, Bangladesh and the Philippines all have more total cooling degree day exposure than the United States—a country that uses 400 terawatt-hours of electricity annually for air conditioning.
abstract_zh: 随着收入增长和平均气温上升，全球空调的普及率正在急剧提高。利用来自14,500个气象站的每日气温数据，我们基于一种被广泛使用的制冷需求指标——总制冷度日暴露量——对219个国家和1,692个城市进行了排序。印度、中国、印度尼西亚、尼日利亚、巴基斯坦、巴西、孟加拉国和菲律宾的总制冷度日暴露量均高于美国——而美国每年用于空调的电量高达400太瓦时。

title: How Effective is Energy-Efficient Housing? Evidence from a Field Trial in Mexico
abstract: This paper evaluates a field experiment in Mexico in which a quasi-experimental sample of new homes was provided with insulation and other energy efficient upgrades. A novel feature of our study is that we deploy large numbers of data loggers which allow us to measure temperature and humidity at high frequency inside homes. We find that the upgrades had no detectable impact on electricity use or thermal comfort, and this is true both in summer and non-summer months. These results stand in contrast to the engineering estimates that predicted up to a 26% decrease in electricity use. Part of the explanation is that air conditioner ownership is lower than expected, thus reducing the potential for reductions in energy use. In addition, we document that most households have their windows open on hot days, nullifying the thermal benefits of roof and wall insulation.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了墨西哥的一项田野实验，在该实验中，一组准实验样本的新建住宅获得了隔热及其他节能改造。本研究的一个新颖之处在于，我们部署了大量数据记录仪，能够高频测量住宅内部的温度和湿度。我们发现，这些改造对用电量或热舒适度没有可检测到的影响，夏季和非夏季月份均是如此。这些结果与工程估计形成对比，工程估计预测用电量最多可减少26%。部分原因在于空调拥有率低于预期，从而减少了节能的潜力。此外，我们记录到大多数家庭在炎热的日子里会开窗，从而抵消了屋顶和墙体隔热的热效益。

title: Should Electric Vehicle Drivers Pay a Mileage Tax?
venue: NBER Environmental and Energy Policy and the Economy
abstract: In many countries, the revenue from gasoline taxes is used to fund highways and other transportation infrastructure. As the number of electric vehicles on the road increases, this raises questions about the effectiveness and equity of this financing mechanism. In this paper, we ask whether electric vehicle drivers should pay a mileage tax. Though the gasoline tax has been traditionally viewed as a benefits tax, we instead take the perspective of economic efficiency. We derive a condition for the optimal electric vehicle mileage tax that highlights a key trade-off. On the one hand, there are externalities from driving, including traffic congestion and accidents, that imply a mileage tax is efficient. On the other hand, gasoline tends to be underpriced, so a low (or even negative) mileage tax might have efficiency benefits in encouraging substitution away from gasoline-powered vehicles. We then turn to an empirical analysis aimed at better understanding the current policy landscape for electric vehicles in the United States. Using newly available, nationally representative microdata, we calculate that electric vehicles have reduced gasoline tax revenues by $250 million annually. We show that the forgone tax revenue is highly concentrated in a handful of states and is highly regressive, as most electric vehicles are driven by high-income households, and we discuss how this motivates and informs optimal policy.
abstract_zh: 在许多国家，汽油税的收入用于资助公路及其他交通基础设施建设。随着道路上电动汽车数量的增加，这一融资机制的有效性与公平性引发了疑问。本文探讨电动汽车驾驶人是否应当缴纳里程税。尽管汽油税传统上被视为一种受益税，我们则从经济效率的角度出发。我们推导了最优电动汽车里程税的条件，该条件凸显了一个关键的权衡。一方面，驾驶带来的外部性，包括交通拥堵和事故，意味着里程税具有效率。另一方面，汽油价格往往被低估，因此较低（甚至为负）的里程税可能通过鼓励人们转向汽油动力车辆之外而具有效率收益。随后，我们转向实证分析，旨在更好地理解美国当前电动汽车的政策格局。利用新近可得的、具有全国代表性的微观数据，我们计算出电动汽车每年使汽油税收入减少了2.5亿美元。我们表明，损失的税收高度集中于少数几个州，并且具有强烈的累退性，因为大多数电动汽车由高收入家庭驾驶；我们还讨论了这一情况如何推动并指导最优政策的制定。

title: An Economic Perspective on Mexico's Nascent Deregulation of Retail Petroleum Markets
abstract: Retail petroleum markets in Mexico are on the cusp of a historic deregulation. For decades, all 11,000 gasoline stations nationwide have carried the brand of the state-owned petroleum company Pemex and sold Pemex gasoline at federally regulated retail prices. This industry structure is changing, however, as part of Mexico's broader energy reforms aimed at increasing private investment. Since April 2016, independent companies can import, transport, store, distribute, and sell gasoline and diesel. In this paper, we provide an economic perspective on Mexico's nascent deregulation. Although in many ways the reforms are unprecedented, we argue that past experiences in other markets give important clues about what to expect, as well as about potential pitfalls. Turning Mexico's retail petroleum sector into a competitive market will not be easy, but the deregulation has enormous potential to increase efficiency and, eventually, to reduce prices.
abstract_zh: 墨西哥的零售石油市场正处于一场具有历史意义的放松管制的关头。数十年来，全国11,000座加油站都挂着国有石油公司Pemex的品牌，并按联邦规定的零售价格销售Pemex汽油。然而，作为墨西哥旨在增加私人投资的更广泛能源改革的一部分，这一产业结构正在改变。自2016年4月起，独立公司可以进口、运输、储存、分销和销售汽油及柴油。本文从经济学视角考察墨西哥初现端倪的放松管制。尽管这些改革在许多方面都是前所未有的，我们认为其他市场的过往经验为预期未来提供了重要线索，也揭示了潜在的陷阱。将墨西哥的零售石油部门转变为竞争性市场并非易事，但这一放松管制具有提高效率的巨大潜力，并最终有助于降低价格。

title: Are Fuel Economy Standards Regressive?
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Despite widespread agreement that a carbon tax would be more efficient, many countries use fuel economy standards to reduce transportation-related carbon dioxide emissions. We pair a simple model of the automakers' profit maximization problem with unusually-rich nationally representative data on vehicle registrations to estimate the distributional impact of U.S. fuel economy standards. The key insight from the model is that fuel economy standards impose a constraint on automakers which creates an implicit subsidy for fuel-efficient vehicles and an implicit tax for fuel-inefficient vehicles. Moreover, when these obligations are tradable, permit prices make it possible to quantify the exact magnitude of these implicit subsidies and taxes. We use the model to determine which U.S. vehicles are most subsidized and taxed, and we compare the pattern of ownership of these vehicles between high-and low-income census tracts. Finally, we compare these distributional impacts with existing estimates in the literature on the distributional impact of a carbon tax.
abstract_zh: 尽管人们普遍认为碳税效率更高，许多国家仍采用燃油经济性标准来减少交通运输相关的二氧化碳排放。我们将汽车制造商利润最大化问题的一个简单模型，与异常丰富的、具有全国代表性的车辆登记数据相结合，以估计美国燃油经济性标准的分配效应。该模型的关键见解在于，燃油经济性标准对汽车制造商施加了一种约束，从而为高燃油效率车辆创造了隐含补贴，并为低燃油效率车辆形成了隐含税负。此外，当这些义务可交易时，许可证价格使我们能够精确量化这些隐含补贴和税负的大小。我们运用该模型确定哪些美国车辆获得的补贴最多、承担的税负最重，并比较了高收入与低收入人口普查区对这些车辆的持有格局。最后，我们将这些分配效应与文献中已有的关于碳税分配效应的估计结果进行了比较。

title: Evidence of a Homeowner-Renter Gap for Electric Vehicles
abstract: This paper provides the first empirical analysis of the homeowner-renter gap for electric vehicles. Using newly-available U.S. nationally representative data, the analysis shows that homeowners are three times more likely than renters to own an electric vehicle. The gap is highly statistically significant, and remains even after controlling for income. For example, among households with annual income between $75,000 and $100,000, 1 in 130 homeowners owns an electric vehicle, compared to 1 in 370 renters. Additional controls do little to narrow the gap. The paper argues that this is a version of what economists have called the “landlord-tenant’’ problem, and briefly discusses potential policy implications.
abstract_zh: 本文首次对电动汽车领域的房主－租户差距进行了实证分析。利用新近可获得的、具有全国代表性的美国数据，分析表明，房主拥有电动汽车的可能性是租户的三倍。该差距具有高度统计显著性，并且在控制收入后依然存在。例如，在年收入介于75,000至100,000美元的家庭中，每130名房主中有1人拥有电动汽车，而每370名租户中仅有1人拥有。进一步的控制变量对缩小该差距作用甚微。本文认为，这是经济学家所称“房东－租户”问题的一个版本，并简要讨论了潜在的政策含义。

title: How Much Are Electric Vehicles Driven?
abstract: The prospect for electric vehicles as a climate change solution hinges on their ability to reduce gasoline consumption. But this depends on how many miles electric vehicles are driven and on how many miles would have otherwise been driven in gasoline-powered vehicles. Using newly-available U.S. nationally representative data, this paper finds that electric vehicles are driven considerably fewer miles per year on average than gasoline-powered vehicles. The difference is highly statistically significant and holds for both all-electric and plug-in hybrid vehicles, for both single- and multiple-vehicle households, and both inside and outside California. The paper discusses potential explanations and policy implications. Overall, the evidence suggests that today’s electric vehicles imply smaller environmental benefits than previously believed.
abstract_zh: 电动汽车作为应对气候变化的方案，其前景取决于其减少汽油消耗的能力。但这取决于电动汽车的行驶里程，以及若非如此原本由燃油汽车行驶的里程。利用新近可获得的、具有全国代表性的美国数据，本文发现，电动汽车的年均行驶里程显著少于燃油汽车。这一差异具有高度统计显著性，对纯电动汽车和插电式混合动力汽车均成立，对单车家庭和多车家庭均成立，并且在加利福尼亚州内外均成立。本文讨论了潜在解释和政策含义。总体而言，证据表明，当今的电动汽车所带来的环境效益小于此前的认识。

title: Anticipation, Tax Avoidance, and the Price Elasticity of Demand for Gasoline
abstract: Least-squares estimates of the response of gasoline consumption to a change in the gasoline price are biased toward zero, given the endogeneity of gasoline prices. A seemingly natural solution to this problem is to instrument for gasoline prices using gasoline taxes, but this approach tends to yield implausibly large price elasticities. We demonstrate that anticipatory behavior provides an important explanation for this result. Gasoline buyers increase purchases before tax increases and delay purchases before tax decreases, rendering the tax instrument endogenous. Including suitable leads and lags in the regression restores the validity of the IV estimator, resulting in much lower elasticity estimates.
abstract_zh: 由于汽油价格存在内生性，汽油消费对汽油价格变化的反应的最小二乘估计会偏向于零。一个看似自然的解决办法是以汽油税作为汽油价格的工具变量，但这种方法往往得出难以置信的大价格弹性。我们证明，预期行为为此结果提供了重要解释。在税收上调前，汽油购买者会增加购买；在税收下调前，他们会推迟购买，这使税收工具变量变得内生。在回归中加入适当的超前项和滞后项，可以恢复IV估计量的有效性，从而得到低得多的弹性估计值。

title: Evidence of a Decline in Electricity Use by U.S. Households
abstract: This paper shows that U.S. households use less electricity than they did five years ago. The decrease has been experienced broadly, in virtually all U.S. states and across all seasons of the year. This pattern stands in sharp contrast to steady increases throughout previous decades and has significant implications for household budgets, energy markets, and the environment. I discuss some of the implications of the decline and then take preliminary steps toward identifying potential explanations. While multiple factors have contributed, I argue that the rapid emergence of LEDs and other energy-efficient lighting has played a particularly important role.
abstract_zh: 本文表明，美国家庭的用电量比五年前有所减少。这一下降几乎遍及所有美国州和一年中的所有季节。这一格局与此前几十年的持续增长形成鲜明对比，并对家庭预算、能源市场和环境具有重要意义。我讨论了这一下降的一些含义，随后初步探讨了其潜在解释。尽管多种因素都有作用，我认为LED及其他节能照明的迅速普及发挥了特别重要的作用。

title: Saturday Driving Restrictions Fail to Improve Air Quality in Mexico City
abstract: Policymakers around the world are turning to license-plate based driving restrictions in an effort to address urban air pollution. The format differs across cities, but most programs restrict driving once or twice a week during weekdays. This paper focuses on Mexico City, home to one of the oldest and best-known driving restriction policies. For almost two decades Mexico City’s driving restrictions applied during weekdays only. This changed recently, however, when the program was expanded to include Saturdays. This paper uses hourly data from pollution monitoring stations to measure the effect of the Saturday expansion on air quality. Overall, there is little evidence that the program expansion improved air quality. Across eight major pollutants, the program expansion had virtually no discernible effect on pollution levels. These disappointing results stand in sharp contrast to estimates made before the expansion which predicted a 15%+ decrease in vehicle emissions on Saturdays. To understand why the program has been less effective than expected, the paper then turns to evidence from subway, bus, and light rail ridership, finding no evidence that the expansion was successful in getting drivers to switch to lower-emitting forms of transportation.
abstract_zh: 世界各地的政策制定者正转向基于车牌的限行措施，以应对城市空气污染。各城市的做法各不相同，但大多数项目每周在工作日限制驾驶一到两次。本文聚焦墨西哥城，该市拥有最古老、最知名的限行政策之一。近二十年来，墨西哥城的限行仅在工作日实施。然而，最近该项目扩展至周六，情况发生了变化。本文利用空气污染监测站的逐小时数据，衡量周六扩展对空气质量的影响。总体而言，几乎没有证据表明该项目扩展改善了空气质量。在八种主要污染物中，项目扩展对污染水平几乎没有可辨别的影响。这些令人失望的结果，与扩展前预测周六汽车排放将减少15%以上的估计形成鲜明对比。为理解该项目为何不如预期有效，本文转而考察地铁、公交和轻轨的乘客数据，发现没有证据表明扩展成功让驾驶者转向排放较低的交通方式。

title: The Environmental Cost of Global Fuel Subsidies
abstract: Despite increasing calls for reform many countries continue to provide subsidies for gasoline and diesel. This paper quantifies the external costs from global fuel subsidies using the latest available data and estimates from the World Bank and International Monetary Fund. Under preferred assumptions about supply and demand elasticities, current subsidies cause $44 billion in external costs annually. This includes $8 billion from carbon dioxide emissions, $7 billion from local pollutants, $12 billion from traffic congestion, and $17 billion from accidents. These external costs are in addition to conventional deadweight loss, estimated to be $26 billion annually. Government incentives for alternative fuel vehicles are unlikely to cost-effectively reduce these externalities as they do little to address traffic congestion or accidents and only indirectly address carbon dioxide and local pollutants.
abstract_zh: 尽管要求改革的呼声日益高涨，许多国家仍继续为汽油和柴油提供补贴。本文利用世界银行和国际货币基金组织的最新可得数据与估计，量化了全球燃料补贴的外部成本。在关于供需弹性的首选假设下，目前的补贴每年造成440亿美元的外部成本。其中包括二氧化碳排放造成的80亿美元、地方污染物造成的70亿美元、交通拥堵造成的120亿美元以及事故造成的170亿美元。这些外部成本之外，还有传统的无谓损失，估计每年为260亿美元。政府对替代燃料汽车的激励措施不太可能以具有成本效益的方式减少这些外部性，因为它们对交通拥堵或事故几乎没有作用，对二氧化碳和地方污染物的作用也只是间接的。

title: Does Better Information Lead to Better Choices? Evidence from Energy-Efficiency Labels
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Information provision is a key element of government energy-efficiency policy, but the information that is provided is often too coarse to allow consumers to make efficient decisions. An important example is the ubiquitous yellow “EnergyGuide” label, which is required by law to be displayed on all major appliances sold in the United States. These labels report energy cost information based on average national usage and energy prices. We conduct an online stated-choice experiment to measure the potential welfare benefits from labels tailored to each household’s state of residence. We find that state-specific labels lead to significantly better choices. Consumers choose to invest about the same amount overall in energy efficiency, but the allocation is much better with more investment in high-usage high-price states and less investment in low-usage low-price states.
abstract_zh: 信息提供是政府能效政策的关键要素，但所提供的信息往往过于粗略，使消费者无法做出有效率的决策。一个典型例子是随处可见的黄色“EnergyGuide”标签，美国法律要求其展示在所有销售的主要家电上。这些标签基于全国平均使用量和能源价格报告能源成本信息。我们开展了一项在线陈述选择实验，以衡量针对每个家庭所在州量身定制的标签所能带来的潜在福利收益。我们发现，按州定制的标签能显著带来更好的选择。消费者在能效方面的总投资额大致相同，但在高使用量、高价格的州投入更多，在低使用量、低价格的州投入更少，资源配置显著改善。

title: Market Impacts of a Nuclear Power Plant Closure
abstract: Falling revenues and rising costs have put US nuclear plants in financial trouble, and some threaten to close. To understand the potential private and social consequences, we examine the abrupt closure of the San Onofre Nuclear Generating Station (SONGS) in 2012. Using a novel econometric approach, we show that the lost generation from SONGS was met largely by increased in-state natural gas generation. In the twelve months following the closure, natural gas generation costs increased by $350 million. The closure also created binding transmission constraints, causing short-run inefficiencies and potentially making it more profitable for certain plants to act noncompetitively. (JEL D24, L25, L94, L98, Q42, Q48)
abstract_zh: 收入下降和成本上升使美国核电厂陷入财务困境，部分电厂面临关闭的威胁。为了解其潜在的私人和社会后果，我们考察了2012年圣奥诺弗雷核电站（SONGS）的突然关闭。采用一种新颖的计量方法，我们发现，SONGS损失的发电量很大程度上由州内增加的天然气发电所补足。关闭后的十二个月内，天然气发电成本增加了3.5亿美元。关闭还产生了具有约束力的输电约束，导致短期效率低下，并可能使某些电厂更有利可图地采取非竞争性行为。（JEL D24, L25, L94, L98, Q42, Q48）

title: The Distributional Effects of U.S. Clean Energy Tax Credits
venue: NBER Tax Policy and the Economy
abstract: Since 2006, U.S. households have received more than $18 billion in federal income tax credits for weatherizing their homes, installing solar panels, buying hybrid and electric vehicles, and other "clean energy" investments. We use tax return data to examine the socioeconomic characteristics of program recipients. We find that these tax expenditures have gone predominantly to higher-income Americans. The bottom three income quintiles have received about 10% of all credits, while the top quintile has received about 60%.The most extreme is the program aimed at electric vehicles, where we find that the top income quintile has received about 90% of all credits. By comparing to previous work on the distributional consequences of pricing greenhouse gas emissions, we conclude that tax credits are likely to be much less attractive on distributional grounds than market mechanisms to reduce GHGs.
abstract_zh: 自2006年以来，美国家庭已获得超过180亿美元的联邦所得税抵免，用于房屋节能改造、安装太阳能板、购买混合动力和电动汽车以及其他“清洁能源”投资。我们利用纳税申报数据考察项目受益人的社会经济特征。我们发现，这些税收支出主要流向了高收入美国人。收入最低的三个五分位组仅获得了约10%的抵免，而最高五分位组获得了约60%。最极端的是针对电动汽车的项目，我们发现收入最高的五分位组获得了约90%的抵免。通过与此前关于温室气体排放定价的分配后果的研究进行比较，我们得出结论：从分配角度看，税收抵免很可能远不如减少温室气体的市场机制有吸引力。

title: Bonding Requirements for Natural Gas Producers
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: Natural gas producers are constantly making tradeoffs between money, time, and environmental risk. The private costs and benefits of drilling are realized immediately, but the external costs are not. This means that by the time external costs are well understood, producers may no longer exist or may not have sufficient resources to finance necessary cleanups or to compensate those who have been adversely affected. Because producers do not face the total cost of potential external damages, they may take too many risks. This article discusses alternative regulatory approaches for mitigating moral hazard in U.S. natural gas production. Particular emphasis is given to bonding requirements, which have tended to receive less attention from policy makers than other approaches but have a long history. Although the use of bonding has important limitations, this approach is quite well suited to addressing many of the environmental risks in this market.
abstract_zh: 天然气生产商不断在金钱、时间和环境风险之间进行权衡。钻探的私人成本和收益即时实现，但外部成本则不然。这意味着，等到外部成本被充分认识时，生产商可能已不复存在，或者可能没有足够的资源为必要的清理工作提供资金，或补偿那些受到不利影响的人。由于生产商并不承担潜在外部损害的全部成本，他们可能会承担过多风险。本文讨论了缓解美国天然气生产道德风险的各种监管方法。文章特别强调保证金（bonding）要求，它与其他方法相比较少受到政策制定者的关注，但有着悠久的历史。尽管保证金制度有重要的局限性，但该方法非常适合应对该市场中的许多环境风险。

title: Contribution of Air Conditioning Adoption to Future Energy Use under Global Warming
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: The use of air conditioning is poised to increase dramatically over the next several decades as global temperatures go up and incomes rise around the world. In this paper, we use high-quality microdata from Mexico to characterize empirically the relationship between temperature, income, and air conditioning. We describe both how electricity consumption increases with temperature given current levels of air conditioning, and how climate and income drive air conditioning adoption decisions. We then combine these estimates with predicted end-of-century temperature changes to forecast future energy consumption. Overall, our results point to air conditioning impacts being considerably larger than previously believed.
abstract_zh: 随着全球气温在未来几十年内上升、各国收入增长，空调的使用有望大幅增加。本文利用墨西哥的高质量微观数据，实证刻画了温度、收入与空调之间的关系。我们描述了在当前空调水平下，用电量如何随温度上升，以及气候和收入如何驱动空调采用决策。随后，我们将这些估计与预测的本世纪末气温变化相结合，以预测未来的能源消费。总体而言，我们的结果表明，空调的影响远大于此前的认识。

title: Environmental Health Risks and Housing Values: Evidence from 1,600 Toxic Plant Openings and Closings
abstract: Regulatory oversight of toxic emissions from industrial plants and understanding about these emissions' impacts are in their infancy. Applying a research design based on the openings and closings of 1,600 industrial plants to rich data on housing markets and infant health, we find that: toxic air emissions affect air quality only within 1 mile of the plant; plant openings lead to 11 percent declines in housing values within 0.5 mile or a loss of about $4.25 million for these households; and a plant's operation is associated with a roughly 3 percent increase in the probability of low birthweight within 1 mile. (JEL I12, L60, Q52, Q53, Q58, R23, R31)
abstract_zh: 对工业设施有毒排放的监管监督，以及对这些排放影响的认识，仍处于起步阶段。我们以1600家工业设施的开业与关闭为基础设计研究，并结合丰富的住房市场和婴儿健康数据，发现：有毒大气排放仅在工厂1英里范围内影响空气质量；工厂开业导致0.5英里范围内的住房价值下降11%，即这些家庭损失约425万美元；工厂运营与1英里范围内低出生体重概率约3%的上升相关。（JEL I12, L60, Q52, Q53, Q58, R23, R31）

title: A Credible Approach for Measuring Inframarginal Participation in Energy Efficiency Programs
abstract: Economists have long argued that many recipients of energy-efficiency subsidies may be “non-additional,” getting paid to do what they would have done anyway. Demonstrating this empirically has been difficult, however, because of endogeneity concerns and other challenges. In this paper we use a regression discontinuity analysis to examine participation in a large-scale residential energy-efficiency program. Comparing behavior just on either side of several eligibility thresholds, we find that program participation increases with larger subsidy amounts, but that most households would have participated even with much lower subsidy amounts. We illustrate the welfare loss introduced by transfers to inframarginal participants and show how the optimal subsidy amount depends on the relative shares of marginal and inframarginal participants.
abstract_zh: 经济学家长期以来认为，许多能效补贴的领取者可能属于“非额外性”群体，即获得补贴去做他们本来就会做的事情。然而，由于内生性问题及其他挑战，以实证方式证明这一点一直十分困难。本文利用断点回归分析，考察一项大规模住宅能效项目中的参与情况。通过比较若干资格门槛两侧的行为，我们发现项目参与随补贴金额增加而上升，但大多数家庭即使在远低得多的补贴金额下也会参与。我们说明了向边际内参与者转移支付所带来的福利损失，并展示了最优补贴金额如何取决于边际参与者与边际内参与者的相对份额。

title: An Economic Perspective on the EPA's Clean Power Plan
abstract: In June, the Obama Administration unveiled its proposal for a Clean Power Plan, which it estimates would reduce carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions from existing U.S. power plants 30% below 2005 levels by 2030. Power plant emissions have declined substantially since 2005, so the plan is seeking reductions of about 18% from current levels. Electricity generation accounts for about 40% of U.S. CO2 emissions. We examine whether the plan will achieve its intended emissions reductions, and how it can do so in the most cost-effective manner, highlighting the role of cross-state coordination in lowering compliance costs.
abstract_zh: 6月，奥巴马政府公布了其《清洁电力计划》提案，估计该计划将使现有美国发电厂的二氧化碳（CO2）排放相较2005年水平在2030年降低30%。自2005年以来，发电厂排放已大幅下降，因此该计划所寻求的是相对于当前水平约18%的减排。发电约占美国二氧化碳排放的40%。我们考察该计划能否实现其预期的减排目标，以及如何以最具成本效益的方式实现，并强调州际协调在降低合规成本中的作用。

title: Cash for Coolers: Evaluating a Large-Scale Appliance Replacement Program in Mexico
abstract: This paper evaluates a large-scale appliance replacement program in Mexico that from 2009 to 2012 helped 1.9 million households replace their old refrigerators and air conditioners with energy-efficient models. Using household-level billing records from  the universe of Mexican residential customers, we find that refrigerator replacement reduces electricity consumption by 8 percent, about one-quarter of what was predicted by ex ante analyses. Moreover, we find that air conditioning replacement actually increases electricity consumption. Overall, we find that the program is an expensive way to reduce externalities from energy use, reducing carbon dioxide emissions at a program cost of over $500 per ton. (JEL L68, L94, O12, O13, Q41, Q54)
abstract_zh: 本文评估了墨西哥一项大规模电器更换项目，该项目在2009至2012年间帮助190万户家庭以节能型号替换了旧冰箱和空调。利用墨西哥全部住宅用户的家庭层面账单记录，我们发现，冰箱更换可使用电量减少8%，约为事前分析预测值的四分之一。此外，我们发现空调更换实际上增加了用电量。总体而言，我们发现该项目是减少能源使用外部性的昂贵方式，其每吨二氧化碳减排的项目成本超过500美元。（JEL L68, L94, O12, O13, Q41, Q54）

title: The Economic Cost of Global Fuel Subsidies
venue: American Economic Review: Papers and Proceedings
abstract: By 2015, global oil consumption will reach 90 million barrels per day. In part, this high level of consumption reflects the fact that many countries provide subsidies for gasoline and diesel. This paper examines global fuel subsidies using the latest available data from the World Bank, finding that road-sector subsidies for gasoline and diesel totaled $110 billion in 2012. Pricing fuels below cost is inefficient because it leads to overconsumption. Under baseline assumptions about supply and demand elasticities, the total annual deadweight loss worldwide is $44 billion. Incorporating external costs increases the economic costs substantially.
abstract_zh: 到2015年，全球石油消费量将达到每日9000万桶。在一定程度上，这一高消费水平反映了许多国家为汽油和柴油提供补贴的事实。本文利用世界银行的最新可得数据考察全球燃料补贴，发现2012年道路交通部门的汽油和柴油补贴总额为1100亿美元。将燃料价格定在成本以下是低效的，因为这会导致过度消费。在基准的供需弹性假设下，全球每年的总无谓损失为440亿美元。纳入外部成本会大幅增加经济成本。

title: Are Renters Less Likely to Have Energy-Efficient Appliances?
venue: Design and Implementation of U.S. Climate Policy
abstract: While public discussion of HR 2454 (the “Waxman-Markey” bill) has focused on the cap-and-trade program that would be established for carbon emissions, the bill also includes provisions that would tighten energy efficiency standards for consumer appliances. Supporters argue that appliance standards help address a number of market failures. In particular, many studies have pointed out that landlords may buy cheap inefficient appliances when their tenants pay the utility bill. Although this landlord-tenant problem has been widely discussed in the literature, there is little empirical evidence on the magnitude of the distortion. This paper compares appliance ownership patterns between homeowners and renters using household-level data from the Residential Energy Consumption Survey. The results show that, controlling for household income and other household characteristics, renters are significantly less likely to have energy-efficient refrigerators, clothes washers, and dishwashers.
abstract_zh: 尽管公众对HR 2454（“Waxman-Markey”法案）的讨论主要集中在为碳排放设立的总量控制与交易计划上，但该法案也包括收紧消费电器能效标准的条款。支持者认为，电器标准有助于解决多种市场失灵问题。特别是，许多研究指出，当租户支付电费时，房东可能会购买廉价的低效电器。尽管这一房东－租户问题已在文献中得到广泛讨论，但关于其扭曲程度的实证证据很少。本文利用住宅能源消费调查的家庭层面数据，比较了房主与租户的电器拥有情况。结果显示，在控制家庭收入和其他家庭特征后，租户拥有节能冰箱、洗衣机和洗碗机的可能性显著更低。

title: Deregulation, Consolidation, and Efficiency: Evidence from U.S. Nuclear Power
abstract: For the first four decades of its existence the U.S. nuclear power industry was run by regulated utilities, with most companies owning only one or two reactors. Beginning in the late 1990s electricity markets in many states were deregulated and almost half of the nation's 103 reactors were sold to independent power producers selling power in competitive wholesale markets. Deregulation has been accompanied by substantial market consolidation and today the three largest companies control more than one-third of all U.S. nuclear capacity. We find that deregulation and consolidation are associated with a 10 percent increase in operating efficiency, achieved primarily by reducing the frequency and duration of reactor outages. At average wholesale prices the value of this increased efficiency is approximately $2.5 billion annually and implies an annual decrease of almost 40 million metric tons of carbon dioxide emissions.
abstract_zh: 在美国核电行业存在的前四十年，该行业由受监管的公用事业公司运营，大多数公司仅拥有一两座反应堆。从20世纪90年代末开始，许多州的电力市场放松管制，全国103座反应堆中近一半被出售给在竞争性批发市场售电的独立发电商。放松管制伴随着大规模的市场整合，如今三大公司控制着美国超过三分之一的核电装机容量。我们发现，放松管制与整合与运营效率提高10%相关，这主要通过减少反应堆停运的频率和时长实现。按平均批发价格计算，这一效率提升的价值约为每年25亿美元，并意味着每年减少近4000万公吨二氧化碳排放。

title: Prospects for Nuclear Power
abstract: Nuclear power has long been controversial because of concerns about nuclear accidents, storage of spent fuel, and how the spread of nuclear power might raise risks of the proliferation of nuclear weapons. These concerns are real and important. However, emphasizing these concerns implicitly suggests that unless these issues are taken into account, nuclear power would otherwise be cost effective compared to other forms of electricity generation. This implication is unwarranted. Throughout the history of nuclear power, a key challenge has been the high cost of construction for nuclear plants. Construction costs are high enough that it becomes difficult to make an economic argument for nuclear even before incorporating these external factors. This is particularly true in countries like the United States where recent technological advances have dramatically increased the availability of natural gas. The chairman of one of the largest U.S. nuclear companies recently said that his company would not break ground on a new nuclear plant until the price of natural gas was more than double today's level and carbon emissions cost $25 per ton. This comment summarizes the current economics of nuclear power pretty well. Yes, there is a certain confluence of factors that could make nuclear power a viable economic option. Otherwise, a nuclear power renaissance seems unlikely.
abstract_zh: 核电长期以来备受争议，原因在于人们对核事故、乏燃料储存，以及核电扩散可能增加核武器扩散风险的担忧。这些担忧是真实而重要的。然而，过分强调这些担忧，实际上暗示着如果不考虑这些问题，核电相比其他形式的发电本来是具有成本效益的。这一暗示是没有根据的。纵观核电历史，一个关键挑战是核电站的高昂建设成本。即使在考虑这些外部因素之前，建设成本之高也使得对核电进行经济论证变得困难。在美国等国家尤其如此，那里近期的技术进步极大地增加了天然气的供应。美国最大核电公司之一的董事长最近表示，除非天然气价格达到今天水平的两倍以上且碳排放成本达到每吨25美元，否则他的公司不会开工建设新的核电站。这一评论很好地概括了当前核电的经济状况。是的，存在某种因素的汇合，可能使核电成为可行的经济选择。否则，核电复兴似乎不太可能。

title: The Equity and Efficiency of Two-Part Tariffs in U.S. Natural Gas Markets
abstract: Residential natural gas customers in the United States face volumetric charges for natural gas that average about 30% more than marginal cost. The large markup on natural gas -which is used to cover the fixed infrastructure and operating costs of the local distribution companies -is widely recognized to be inefficient. Nonetheless, attempts to reduce volumetric charges, and cover the revenue shortfall through increased fixed monthly fees, have faced opposition based on the belief that current rate schedules have desirable distributional consequences. We evaluate this claim empirically using nationally-representative household-level data. We find that natural gas consumption is weakly correlated with household income, so current rate schedules are only mildly progressive. Under current rate schedules, high-volume customers pay a disproportionately large share of fixed costs, but these exhibit a weak correlation with high-income households. The correlation is somewhat weaker still when we consider alternative indicators of household financial stress, such as poverty status or number of children in the household. We show, for example, that poor households with multiple children would receive lower bills on average under marginal cost pricing. We present evidence that one cause of the weak redistributional impact of the current pricing policy is that the poor tend to live in less energy efficient homes.
abstract_zh: 美国居民天然气客户所面临的按量计费价格，平均比边际成本高出约30%。这一用于覆盖配气公司固定基础设施和运营成本的大幅加价，被广泛认为是低效的。尽管如此，减少按量收费、并通过提高固定月费来弥补收入缺口的尝试，却因人们相信现行费率结构具有理想的再分配效果而遭到反对。我们利用具有全国代表性的家庭层面数据对这一主张进行了实证评估。我们发现，天然气消费与家庭收入仅有微弱相关，因此现行费率结构只有轻微的累进性。在现行费率结构下，高用量客户承担的固定成本份额不成比例地高，但这些成本与高收入家庭之间的相关性较弱。当我们考虑其他家庭财务压力指标（如贫困状况或家中子女数量）时，相关性更弱。例如，我们表明，若按边际成本定价，多子女的贫困家庭平均将获得更低的账单。我们提供证据表明，现行定价政策再分配作用较弱的一个原因是，贫困家庭倾向于居住在能效较低的住房中。

title: Estimating the Effect of a Gasoline Tax on Carbon Emissions
abstract: Recently the proposal has been made to raise gasoline taxes in the United States to curb carbon emissions. The existing literature on the sensitivity of gasoline consumption to changes in price may not be appropriate for evaluating the effectiveness of such a tax. First, most of these studies fail to address the endogeneity of gasoline prices. Second, the responsiveness of gasoline consumption to a change in tax may differ from the responsiveness of consumption to an average change in price. We address these challenges using a variety of methods including traditional single‐equation regression models, estimated by least squares or instrumental variables methods, and structural vector autoregressions. Our preferred approach exploits the historical variation in US federal and state gasoline taxes. Our most credible estimates imply that a 10‐cent per gallon increase in the gasoline tax would reduce carbon emissions from vehicles in the United States by about 1.5%. Copyright © 2010 John Wiley & Sons, Ltd.
abstract_zh: 近来有人提议提高美国汽油税以遏制碳排放。关于汽油消费对价格变化敏感性的现有文献，可能不适用于评估此类税收的有效性。首先，这些研究大多未能处理汽油价格的内生性问题。其次，汽油消费对税收变化的反应可能与其对平均价格变化的反应不同。我们使用多种方法应对这些挑战，包括传统的单方程回归模型（采用最小二乘法或工具变量法估计）以及结构向量自回归模型。我们偏好的方法利用美国联邦和州汽油税的历史变化。我们最可信的估计表明，汽油税每加仑提高10美分，将使美国汽车的碳排放减少约1.5%。版权所有 © 2010 John Wiley & Sons, Ltd.

title: The Allocative Cost of Price Ceilings in the U.S. Residential Market for Natural Gas
abstract: A direct consequence of imposing a ceiling on the price of a good for which secondary markets do not exist, is that, when there is excess demand, the good will not be allocated to the buyers who value it the most. The resulting allocative cost has been discussed in the literature as a potentially important component of the total welfare loss from price ceilings, but its practical importance has yet to be established empirically. In this paper, we address this question using data for the U.S. residential market for natural gas which was subject to price ceilings during 1954-1989.This market is well suited for such an empirical analysis and natural gas price ceilings affected millions of households. Using a household-level, discrete-continuous model of natural gas demand, we estimate that the allocative cost in the U.S. residential market for natural gas averaged $4.6 billion annually since the 1950s, effectively tripling previous estimates of the net welfare loss to U.S. consumers. We quantify the evolution of this allocative cost and its geographical distribution during the post-war period, and we highlight implications of our analysis for the regulation of other markets.
abstract_zh: 对于一种不存在二级市场的商品实施价格上限，其直接后果是：当存在超额需求时，该商品不会分配给最看重它的买家。由此产生的配置成本在文献中被视为价格上限所造成总福利损失的一个潜在重要组成部分，但其现实重要性尚未得到实证确立。本文利用美国住宅天然气市场1954–1989年间受价格上限约束的数据来解决这一问题。该市场非常适合进行此类实证分析，且天然气价格上限影响了数百万户家庭。利用家庭层面的离散－连续天然气需求模型，我们估计，自20世纪50年代以来，美国住宅天然气市场的配置成本平均每年为46亿美元，这使先前对美国消费者净福利损失的估计值增至三倍。我们量化了战后时期这一配置成本的演变及其地理分布，并阐述了本分析对其他市场监管的启示。

title: The Effect of Power Plants on Local Housing Prices and Rents
abstract: This paper uses restricted census microdata to examine housing values and rents for neighborhoods in the United States where power plants were opened during the 1990s. Compared to neighborhoods with similar housing and demographic characteristics, neighborhoods within 2 miles of plants experienced 3%–7% decreases in housing values and rents, with some evidence of larger decreases within 1 mile and for large-capacity plants. In addition, there is evidence of taste-based sorting, with neighborhoods near plants associated with modest but statistically significant decreases in mean household income, educational attainment, and the proportion owner-occupied.
abstract_zh: 本文利用受限的人口普查微观数据，考察了1990年代新建发电厂所在美国社区的房屋价值和租金。与房屋和人口特征相似的社区相比，距离发电厂2英里以内的社区，房屋价值和租金下降了3%–7%，并有证据表明，距离1英里以内以及大型发电厂周边的降幅更大。此外，有证据表明存在基于偏好的分类（taste-based sorting）：靠近发电厂的社区，其平均家庭收入、教育程度和自有住房比例均有适度但具有统计显著性的下降。

title: The Effects of Preferential VAT Rates Near International Borders: Evidence from Mexico
abstract: Most goods and services in Mexico are subject to a 16 percent value added tax (VAT). However, within 20 kilometers of the border with the United States, the VAT rate is 11 percent. This preferential rate was implemented by the Mexican Department of Revenue to reduce cross-border shopping in the United States. However, the tax differential also creates an unusual distortion within Mexico, encouraging Mexicans to travel to the preferential tax zone for shopping. This paper performs an empirical test of tax avoidance using the Mexican Economic Census, comparing towns on either side of the 20 kilometer threshold using a regression discontinuity design. The analysis provides evidence of a modest but statistically significant distortion in economic activity toward the preferential tax zone.

title: Do Americans Consume Too Little Natural Gas?
abstract: This article measures the extent to which prices exceed marginal costs in the U.S. natural gas distribution market during the period 1991–2007. We find large departures from marginal cost pricing in all 50 states, with residential and commercial customers facing average markups of over 40%. Based on conservative estimates of the price elasticity of demand, these distortions impose hundreds of millions of dollars of annual welfare loss. Moreover, current price schedules are an important preexisting distortion which should be taken into account when evaluating carbon taxes and other policies aimed at addressing external costs.
abstract_zh: 本文测算了1991–2007年间美国天然气分销市场中价格超出边际成本的程度。我们发现，全部50个州都存在大幅偏离边际成本定价的情况，住宅和商业客户面临的平均加价超过40%。基于对需求价格弹性的保守估计，这些扭曲每年造成数亿美元的福利损失。此外，现行价格表是一种重要的既有扭曲，在评估碳税及其他旨在应对外部成本的政策时，应当予以考虑。

title: International Trade in Used Vehicles: The Environmental Consequences of NAFTA
abstract: Since trade restrictions were eliminated in 2005, Mexico has imported over 2.5 million used vehicles from the United States. Using a unique, vehicle-level dataset, we find that traded vehicles are dirtier than the stock of vehicles in the United States and cleaner than the stock in Mexico, so when a vehicle is traded from the United States to Mexico average vehicle emissions per mile tend to decrease in both countries. Overall, however, the evidence suggests that trade has increased total lifetime emissions, primarily because of low vehicle retirement rates in Mexico. (JEL F13, F14, L62, O13, O19, Q53, Q56)
abstract_zh: 自2005年取消贸易限制以来，墨西哥已从美国进口了超过250万辆二手车。利用独特的车辆层面数据，我们发现，跨境交易的车辆比美国车辆存量更脏，但比墨西哥车辆存量更干净，因此当车辆从美国转移到墨西哥时，两国的每英里平均车辆排放往往都会下降。然而，总体而言，证据表明贸易增加了车辆的终生排放总量，主要原因是墨西哥的车辆报废率较低。（JEL F13, F14, L62, O13, O19, Q53, Q56）

title: The Welfare Costs of Unreliable Water Service
abstract: Throughout the developing world, many water distribution systems are unreliable. As a result, it becomes necessary for each household to store its own water as a hedge against this uncertainty. Since arrivals of water are not synchronized across households, serious distributional inefficiencies arise. We develop a model describing the optimal intertemporal depletion of each household's private water storage if it is uncertain when water will next arrive to replenish supplies. The model is calibrated using survey data from Mexico City, a city where many households store water in sealed rooftop tanks known as tinacos. The calibrated model is used to evaluate the potential welfare gains that would occur if alternative modes of water provision were implemented.
abstract_zh: 在整个发展中世界，许多供水系统并不可靠。因此，每个家庭都有必要自行储存用水，以对冲这种不确定性。由于各家庭的来水时间并不同步，会产生严重的分配效率低下。我们建立了一个模型，描述在不确定何时会有水来补充供应的情况下，每个家庭私人水储备的最优跨期消耗。该模型利用墨西哥城的调查数据进行校准，在墨西哥城，许多家庭将水储存在密封的屋顶水箱（称为tinacos）中。校准后的模型用于评估若实施替代性供水方式，可能带来的潜在福利收益。

title: Durable Goods and Residential Demand for Energy and Water: Evidence from a Field Trial
abstract: This article describes a household production model in which energy‐efficient durable goods cost less to operate so households may use them more. The model is estimated using household‐level data from a field trial in which participants received high‐efficiency clothes washers free of charge. The estimation strategy exploits this quasi‐random replacement of washers to derive precise estimates of the household production technology and a demand function for clothes washing. During the field trial, households increased clothes washing on average by 5.6% after receiving a high‐efficiency washer, implying a price elasticity of −.06. The complete model is used to evaluate the cost‐effectiveness of recent changes in minimum efficiency standards for clothes washers.
abstract_zh: 本文描述了一个家庭生产模型，在该模型中，节能耐用品的运行成本更低，因此家庭可能更多地使用它们。该模型利用一项田野试验中的家庭层面数据进行估计，在试验中，参与者免费获得了高能效洗衣机。估计策略利用洗衣机的准随机更换，以得出家庭生产技术和洗衣需求函数的精确估计。在田野试验期间，家庭在获得高能效洗衣机后，洗衣次数平均增加了5.6%，对应的价格弹性为−0.06。该完整模型用于评估近期洗衣机最低能效标准调整的成本效益。

title: The Effect of Driving Restrictions on Air Quality in Mexico City
abstract: In 1989, the government of Mexico City introduced a program, Hoy No Circula, that bans most drivers from using their vehicles one weekday per week on the basis of the last digit of the vehicle’s license plate. This article measures the effect of the driving restrictions on air quality using high‐frequency measures from monitoring stations. Across pollutants and specifications there is no evidence that the restrictions have improved air quality. Evidence from additional sources indicates that the restrictions led to an increase in the total number of vehicles in circulation as well as a change in composition toward high‐emissions vehicles.
abstract_zh: 1989年，墨西哥城政府推出了“Hoy No Circula”（今天不上路）计划，该计划根据车辆车牌的末位数字，禁止大多数司机每周一个工作日用车。本文利用监测站的高频测量数据，衡量限行政策对空气质量的影响。在各类污染物和各种设定下，都没有证据表明限行改善了空气质量。其他来源的证据表明，限行导致路上行驶的车辆总数增加，同时车辆构成向高排放车辆转变。

title: The Effect of Health Risk on Housing Values: Evidence from a Cancer Cluster
abstract: This paper measures the impact of an outbreak of pediatric leukemia on local housing values. A model of location choice is used to describe conditions under which the gradient of the hedonic price function with respect to pediatric leukemia risk is equal to household marginal willingness to pay to avoid risk. This equalizing differential is estimated using property-level sales records from a county in Nevada where residents recently experienced a severe increase in pediatric leukemia. Housing prices are compared before and after the increase with a nearby county acting as a control group. The variation in health risk over time makes it possible to control for unobserved differences across locations.
